mentions.name: IterOps
mentions.description: A web analytics tool that provides heat mapping, rage click and dead click tracking, scroll mapping, and simple A/B testing to show how visitors interact with a website. Originally built to understand visitor behavior on the author's micro-SaaS projects and now offered as a standalone product.
mentions.problem: Lack of visibility into what visitors are actually doing on a website.
mentions.source_excerpt: This week I launched IterOps https://iterops.com, a heat mapping, rage click, dead click, scroll mapping, and simple A/B testing tool. I originally built it to have a better idea of what people are doing on my other micro-saas projects
